'''Misterfett Draw out the shield.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Misterfett]]
* '''Published:''' 7 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FirstMove Misterfett DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Make atvantage that the opponent can play only three shields.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

The idea is do draw out the shields, so some strategies come trough. Race will get one, number will, etc netc. They cannot counter all shields, so some strategies will come through.
